description: Source-only L4 compiler: six business artifacts plus a deterministic finalize. No derived copies. CB/CF are never dispatched.
principles: An artifact carries only what it owns and references the rest by id. sourceRefs, realization, resolution, contexts, operationIds, workspace*, landing*, copied useRules and story prose are forbidden.
The l4 is the only source of business meaning. Downstream agents transcribe; they do not infer.
Sequence is declared in this file via dependsOn and done-anchors. Steps do not enqueue their successor by name.
Pipeline state lives on disk at l4/{module}/pipeline/pipeline.json. The task record is orchestration, not truth.
A step declared here and not implemented stops the run with pipeline.status awaitingStep naming that step. The task completes without failed.
Six clarification anchors (journeys20, ontology30, rules40, workflows50, access60, integration70) exist as reserved and have no screen. module10 and finalize80 have none. /fast skips them.
Permanent TypeScript artifacts import Ns5* types from /_102035_/l2/solution/types.js and are emitted as const satisfies.
Deterministic user text is English keys; the planner translates. Internal messages stay English literals.
rules40, workflows50 and access60 run in parallel after ontology30-done. integration70 waits for those three done-anchors. finalize80 waits for integration70-done.
Previous flow versions are never migrated automatically.

invocation.moduleRule: /module is optional. When given it is the folder name; otherwise module10 proposes lowerCamel. The name is a flag, never inferred from prose by the invocation parser.
invocation.rebuildAllRule: /rebuild all calls solution/removeModule: unlinks exact l4/l1/l2/l5/<module>/** (host: localStor.deleteFile; Studio: existing trash), strips that module from l5/config.json, l5/project.json (including nested routeKeys) and the organization registry, then recreates the pipeline from the current prompt. Other modules, l4/organization (except the registry block), l2/designSystem.ts and l2/project.ts stay. An existing module without /rebuild all is refused.
invocation.noHandoff: This flow never dispatches CB or CF. There is no /nochain flag.

steps.goal: Name the module, its actors (with origin) and languages. Actors are stored on pipeline.json, not on module.defs.ts.
Declare business journeys only: actor, entry, steps with affects, decide, outcome.
Entities, mdm, details, lifecycle with allowed transitions, relationships.
Rules as prose: ruleId and description.
Orchestrated processes. Empty list is allowed.
Actors (from pipeline), authorities, grants with structured disclosure.
What enters and leaves the module. Empty list is allowed.
Integrity oracle, organization registry, l5 delivery. Marks pipeline complete. Never dispatches CB/CF.
